purpose: Keep published mounting references separate from the declared numerical support idealizations.

public_sources.reason: Different declared application, and a hardness value does not specify the directional stiffness of a complete mounting.

declared_numerical_cases.rigid: Kinematic reference condition retained for comparison with V6f.

source_copy_policy: Only source references and short factual observations retained; no supplier page, manual, personal data or quote copied.
